fato_historico: 1949: An Air France Lockheed Constellation crashes in the Azores, killing all 48 people on board.
energia_do_dia: The stars invite you to slow down and appreciate the solid earth beneath your feet. Just as the winds carry whispers of distant horizons, consider the precious nature of each breath today. It is a good time to nurture your spirit, focus on comfort, and hold your loved ones close while seeking quiet peace within your own heart.
frase_do_dia: Find beauty in the stillness and strength in every gentle, unfolding moment.
significado_numero: A number representing collective memories and the importance of cherished connections.
conselho: Prioritize your inner tranquility and cherish the people who bring warmth to your life.
